messages:
alex: Quick idea — a safe, ephemeral "replay token" flow for debugging production errors. token gives 10m access to a fully scrubbed request+response snapshot (customer and PII pseudonymized + hashes). Only usable by folks with the debug role and emits audit events.
priya: Real-time access to snapshots sounds useful but we need clear rules for what 'scrubbed' means. hashing emails vs redacting: legal might prefer non-reversible redaction in some regions.
sam: We could HMAC-sensitive fields with a tenant-scoped key so we preserve correlation across requests without exposing raw PII. e.g. `hmac(user_email, tenant_key)` — reversible only by KMS with strict ops approval.
maria: Reversible or not is the big question. If we keep reversible for support, we must log every unmask action and limit TTL strictly. Also retention: snapshots should auto-delete after 30d or less depending on contract.
alex: Proposal sketch: on-demand token flow -> user requests token in Console -> modal shows required approvals -> token valid for 10 minutes and scoped to a single trace id. snapshot stored encrypted, scrub rules applied at write-time.
priya: UX: make it explicit in the Console which fields are pseudonymized vs redacted. a small legend in the modal and an expandable JSON view with markers like `__redacted__` and `__hmac:abc123__`. :eyes:
sam: Agree. Implementation detail: config example for the sampler we discussed:```yaml
sampler:
  mode: on_demand
  token_ttl_seconds: 600
  retention_days: 30
  scrub:
    redact_patterns: ["ssn", "credit_card"]
    pseudonymize_fields: ["user_id", "email"]
    pseudonymize_algo: "hmac-sha256"
  kms_key_ref: "projects/eng/tenant_keys/{tenant_id}"
  audit_log: true
```
maria: Need an ops breakglass path with approvals + automatic email to legal if someone uses 'reveal' in prod. Also rate-limit token creation per-tenant to avoid exfil risk.
alex: Routing/quotas: token creation counts against a tiny admin quota (e.g., 5 tokens / hour per org). will route token fetches to dedicated debug pool so we don't affect latency SLOs.
priya: How do we surface in telemetry? Add a new tag `replay_token=true` and a dashboard that shows token issuance rate, reveal attempts, and failed scrubs.
ops-bot: Deploybot: new feature flag `dbg_replay_tokens` is queued for canary tomorrow at 09:00 UTC — will post rollout link when live.
sam: For rollout plan: canary to internal tenants first (10%), enable audit retention 90 days in staging, then 0.1% external customers, monitor against `tokens_issued` and `scrub_errors` for 48h.
maria: Also run a small privacy review with legal before external canary. I can do that today.
alex: OK — I'll open a short RFC + Console mock and add proposed scrub rules. tagging @priya @sam to review the config. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
